description: This file defines the 'RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter' class which implements a recursive text splitting strategy for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ingestion. It splits text into chunks based on multiple separators, recursively refining the splits to fit within a specified chunk size, and overlaps chunks for contextual continuity.

classes.name: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
classes.description: A class that provides methods to split text recursively into manageable chunks based on separator hierarchy, respecting size constraints and overlaps.

methods.name: List[str] _split_text(self, text: str, separators: List[str], depth: int = 0)
methods.description: Internal recursive method that performs the actual recursive splitting based on separator hierarchy and depth limit.

methods.name: List[str] _merge_splits(self, splits: List[str], separator: str)
methods.description: Merges individual splits into chunks respecting chunk size and overlap constraints.

methods.name: List[str] _force_split(self, text: str)
methods.description: Forcefully splits text into chunks of chunk size when no separators are available.
